item.title: 没有可执行堆栈的 GCC 上嵌套函数的间接调用
item.description:
📝 我们可以不使用trampoline的地址来调用函数，而是可以从trampoline中提取代码地址和静态链，并将它们与__builtin_call_with_static_chain内置函数一起使用，直接调用本地函数。文献 GCC，嵌套函数 GCC，构造函数调用 此代码将一个蹦床放置在堆栈上，并立即通过内联 baz 函数调用它。静态链和代码地址都是蹦床代码中移动指令使用的立即常量。
🔤 Original: Indirect Calling of Nested Functions on GCC Without Executable Stack
🔗 Read more: https://uecker.codeberg.page/2026-08-29.html

item.title: GrapheneOS project: pixel 11 no longer supports hardware memory tagging (MTE)
item.description:
📝 Post GrapheneOS grapheneos. We're unable to complete the port due to lack of support for ARM hardware memory tagging in software, firmware and near certainly hardware. It appears Google cut an important security feature to save money.
🔗 Read more: https://bsky.app/profile/grapheneos.org/post/3mua32q4ds22e
